title: Density-one regular points carry a multiplicity-one oriented C¹ piece (parent B2)
statement: Local multiplicity-one structure at a regular point of density one. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ with m ≥ 1; an open set U ⊆ ℝ^P; T ∈ 𝒟_m(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U m); y ∈ ℝ^P. Hypotheses: y ∈ reg T (regularSet T: y ∈ spt T and, for some ρ_y > 0 with B_{ρ_y}(y) ⊆ U, T(ω) = m_y∫_{M_y}⟨ω, ξ_y⟩ dH^m whenever tsupport ω ⊆ B_{ρ_y}(y), for an integer m_y ≠ 0 and an embedded C¹ m-submanifold M_y ∋ y with orientation ξ_y and H^m(M_y ∩ K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ B_{ρ_y}(y)); and Θ^m(μ_T, y) = 1 (HasMassDensity T y 1). Conclusion: there is ρ₀ > 0 with B_{ρ₀}(y) ⊆ U such that for every ρ ∈ (0, ρ₀] there is ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P m) with (i) spt T ∩ B_ρ(y) an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m); (ii) ξ an orientation of spt T ∩ B_ρ(y) (IsOrientation: ξ continuous there and ξ(x) a unit orientation of tangentSpace(spt T ∩ B_ρ(y), x)); (iii) H^m(spt T ∩ B_ρ(y)) < ∞; (iv) T(ω) = ∫_{spt T ∩ B_ρ(y)} ⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dH^m(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ B_ρ(y). Here H^m = μHE[m] and B_ρ(y) = ball y ρ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U m) (y : Euclid P), 1 ≤ m → IsOpen U → y ∈ regularSet T → HasMassDensity T y 1 → ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ ball y ρ₀ ⊆ U ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ ρ₀ → ∃ ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m (T.support ∩ ball y ρ) ∧ IsOrientation m (T.support ∩ ball y ρ) ξ ∧ μHE[m] (T.support ∩ ball y ρ) ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball y ρ → T ω = ∫ x in T.support ∩ ball y ρ, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]
